name: The Gloaming
theme: Gothic Mistwood, Witchcraft & Barrow Mounds (Cursed Scroll 1)
hazardTable: Bitter Spore Fog (DC 12 CON or coughing fits / reveal stealth)
Quicksand Barrow (DC 13 DEX or sink 1 step per round)
Corrupted Standing Stones (DC 12 WIS or eerie nightmares)
weatherTable: Dense pea-soup fog reducing sight to close
Frost-rimed barrows and brittle reed beds

factions.name: Knights of St. Ydris
factions.notes: Protect pilgrims, maintain the sacred lantern trails, and cleanse barrow horrors.

factions.name: Coven of Bittermold
factions.notes: Brew potent curse draughts and awaken slumbering primeval powers beneath the mounds.

factions.name: Gloaming Fen-Herders
factions.notes: Preserve independent marsh rights and trade medicinal herbs to anyone with silver.

uniqueFloraFauna: Clear forest brook and timber-shored spring
Small turnip plots, trapped hare, and smoked boar
entryConditions: Expedition access point into The Gloaming.
exitConditions: Waymarked return route to Oakhaven Refuge.
